attempts.summary: On node1, created the dedicated system account inventorysvc, installed and enabled a systemd unit (inventory-worker.service) running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user, verified it was active/enabled, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id + running service under inventorysvc), issued systemctl reboot, confirmed the node became unreachable and later reachable again with a changed boot_id, and verified inventory-worker was active, enabled, and running as inventorysvc post-restart (systemd's WantedBy=multi-user.target auto-started it, no manual intervention needed).
